newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Nordbanken/S-E-Banken shares tumble as talks ends.
newsitem.headline: Nordbanken/S-E-Banken shares tumble as talks ends.

text.p: Shares in Swedish commercial bank S-E-Banken and state-controlled Nordbanken tumbled at the open on Monday after merger talks between the two banks ended without conclusion.
Within minutes of trading starting Nordbanken shares had fallen 15 crowns to 220 crowns and continued to fall another 10 crowns to 210 crowns by 0910 GMT.
S-E-Banken shares fell five crowns at the start to 67.5 crowns and remained at this level at 0910 GMT.
The banks released a statement on Monday saying talks over a potential merger were over. Rumours over a merger had circulated the market for months and fuelled banking sector share prices.
"It will come as a bit of a surprise as expectations have been running at a high level," banking analyst Keith Baird from Dresdner Kleinwort Benson told Reuters.
"It will disappoint many in the market. If you look at the run up in the Nordbanken share price it shows there was a lot of credibility given to this."
